⚠️ JAVASCRIPT-RENDERED SITE - Requires Playwright/Selenium ⚠️

This site uses the Real Geeks IDX platform which loads all listings dynamically via JavaScript/AJAX. The listings page (/listings/) contains only an empty div (#buildout) which is populated by JavaScript after page load.

The site claims to have 119 listings according to /our-listings/ page.

Key characteristics:
- Platform: Real Geeks (realgeeks.com)
- Listings container: <div id="buildout"></div> (empty in static HTML)
- Likely uses AJAX API calls to fetch listing data
- Multiple category pages:
  * /listings/ - All properties
  * /listings/?propertyTypes=1,2 - Retail, Office & Restaurant  
  * /listings/?propertyTypes=3 - Industrial & Manufacturing
  * /listings/?propertyTypes=5 - Development & Recreational Land
  * /listings/?propertyUses=1,2,4 - Investment Properties & Businesses

SOLUTION NEEDED:
1. Use Playwright or Selenium to render JavaScript
2. Wait for #buildout to be populated with content
3. Then extract listing cards with selectors like:
   - Container: .listing-card or similar (inspect after JS loads)
   - Title, price, location, property type fields
4. May also be able to intercept API calls to get JSON data directly
